management_notes: CEO Tasheel Jeerh, appointed May 2026 alongside a $700,000 concurrent private placement, is approximately five months into the role. The strategic mandate to accelerate exploration and pursue partnerships is clear, but track record under new leadership remains limited. Prior management built a credible news-flow record in 2025–2026: TSXV approval of the Golden Baie option (March 2026; 15.8M shares + $208K cash to Canstar), a two-rig 4,267-metre spring 2026 Black Raven campaign, and 25M warrant exercises at $0.15 in November 2025 generating $3.75M — evidence of investor commitment at above-market prices. Option pool of 23.45M shares (7.4% of outstanding) is within junior-explorer norms but material at this share count. Specific insider ownership percentages are not available from extracted filings. Score maintained at 3 pending demonstrated track record and clarity on strategic direction.
geology_notes: Black Raven Gold-Silver-Antimony Project in central Newfoundland is the core asset. The spring 2026 two-rig, 23-hole, 4,267-metre campaign confirmed world-class antimony grades: headline result of 19.23% Sb and 0.73 g/t Au across 1.4m at Frost Cove North. Final 2025 holes returned 7.25% Sb over 1.98m and 6.44% Sb over 2.06m. Pomley Cove Pond intersected 20 gold-silver-molybdenum-lead-zinc veins within a 150m-wide structural swarm — meaningful polymetallic optionality. Golden Baie (acquired March 2026) adds a second antimony-gold corridor, both within 100km of Beaver Brook Antimony Mine — the only primary antimony producer in North America and a natural geological and metallurgical comparator. No NI 43-101 resource estimate exists; the base technical report dates to August 2023 and pre-dates the consolidated drilling database. Project remains discovery-stage despite exceptional grades.

Secondary catalysts: first drill results from Golden Baie (systematic trenching and initial program expected to follow TSXV approval in March 2026), any fall 2026 or winter drill program announcement at Black Raven, and progress updates on strategic-partnership or offtake discussions under CEO Jeerh. Antimony's critical-mineral designation by the US, EU, and Canada sustains a meaningful macro tailwind and elevates strategic acquirer interest. No new material announcements identified as of October 10, 2026. Catalyst calendar is constructive but all high-impact events remain ahead.

analyst_summary: Churchill Resources is a discovery-stage antimony-gold explorer in central Newfoundland with two properties — Black Raven and Golden Baie — both proximal to Beaver Brook Antimony Mine, North America's only primary antimony producer. The spring 2026 two-rig Black Raven campaign (4,267m, 23 holes) confirmed world-class grades including 19.23% Sb at Frost Cove North, and the Golden Baie option (TSXV-approved March 2026) consolidates a second antimony-gold corridor. A CEO transition to Tasheel Jeerh in May 2026 signals strategic ambition but adds near-term execution uncertainty. No new material news identified as of October 10, 2026. The core thesis is unchanged: no NI 43-101 resource estimate exists, no P/NAV is calculable, and the share count (316.7M outstanding) limits per-share leverage. WATCH: the maiden Black Raven resource estimate is the catalyst that would trigger a BUY review. Antimony's critical-mineral designation by the US, EU, and Canada distinguishes CRI from generic junior explorers and sustains elevated strategic-acquirer interest.
